evidence: Elastic-recoil detection analysis (ERDA) was performed on 45 -47 nm thick BaB 2O4 films deposited at 325 and 350 /C176C to determine the elemental compositions (Table 1). X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy on a film deposited at 325 /C176C revealed Ba 3d 5/2 and Ba 3d3/2 binding energies... Atomic force microscopy (AFM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) were used to probe the surface morphology of the as-deposited films. All films were amorphous as determined by X-ray diffraction.
